title: Man hurls 'incendiary' at San Francisco home of ChatGPT's Sam Altman
body: The suspect around 4 a.m. "threw an incendiary destructive device at a home, causing a fire to an exterior gate," according to San Francisco police. The suspect also made threats outside the headquarters of Open AI, Altman's Bay Area artificial intelligence startup. Police have not released the suspect's name or motivation.
